name: Rondo
paragraphs: I let my work speak for itself in everything I do. My biggest focus is getting back to my kids and being a father again.

I came to Hope House Guthrie through Logan County Drug Court because I needed a local residence. Having a roof over my head has given me the opportunity to start building a foundation for the rest of my life and hope for a better future.
I'm extremely proud of my 14 months of sobriety. I've held a job for seven months, working six days a week. I've also worked hard to get my driver's license back and get a vehicle.
My main goal now is to become self-sufficient. I'm saving money to move into my own place. When I do, it will open up space at Hope House Guthrie for someone else who may need it.
quote: Hope House Guthrie has given me hope for a better future.
